exposure: complex, dynamic intervention to improve quality of care and survival during pregnancy and childbirth
cohort: Pregnant women and their newborns receiving care at 22 public health facilities in Dar es Salaam, Tanzania, accounting for 60% of the city's facility births.
finding: The intervention resulted in a 41% decongestion of the three most overcrowded hospitals, a comparable increase in use of lower level facilities, a sixfold increase in quality of care, a 47% reduction in facility-based maternal mortality ratio, and a 19% reduction in stillbirth rate.
